statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Available delayed NQ evidence remains roughly flat in the reopened session with no verified repeated extension or failed-retracement sequence; payroll and elevated energy/geopolitical risk keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next major path checkpoint is the reaction after the 12:30 UTC Employment Situation; higher Tail requires observed persistent directional price discovery rather than the scheduled event itself.
headline: Overnight Tail remains low; payrolls define the next major conditional risk window
body: Available delayed NQ evidence is near 29,503 and roughly flat in the reopened session, while U.S. index futures are broadly steady. Thursday's technology-led rally came with easing Treasury yields and a VIX close near 14.5. Brent and WTI remain above $95 and $91 respectively amid renewed U.S.-Iran supply risk, keeping Stress extreme into payrolls.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail was low early on September 3, moved to WATCH around the U.S. event/opening window, became elevated during the late technology-led rally, then normalized through the close and overnight reopen.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because available reopened NQ evidence is roughly flat and does not verify a persistent no-retracement path. Stress remains extreme into payrolls. Forecast Tail stays at or below WATCH before the release and becomes elevated afterward only conditionally if observed price discovery turns persistently directional.

forecast.analysis: By the next hour, the forecast assumes some price discovery has occurred. Tail falls to WATCH unless the market continues to reject retracements and hold near a directional extreme.
Mid-session conditions should reveal whether the opening move is durable or merely volatile. Tail remains WATCH, with normalization favored if counter-swings broaden and volatility decays.
As the session matures, repeated extension without meaningful pullback would still matter, but absent that evidence the baseline shifts toward mixed conditions and lower conditional Tail.
Late U.S. trading remains sensitive to any delayed second leg from payroll repricing. WATCH persists while the main test is whether earlier direction re-accelerates after failed retracements.
Approaching power hour, Tail remains WATCH but eases as event distance grows. A fresh one-way extension with aligned yields and volatility would be needed to reverse that normalization.
Near the U.S. cash close, the forecast favors mixed trade unless the session is still holding an extreme with little retracement. Tail remains WATCH at the low end of the band.
After the cash close, Tail falls back to low if post-event volatility and directional efficiency decay. A disorderly after-hours extension would be the main exception.
Early evening trade is expected to be less event-driven. Low Tail assumes that the payroll reaction has produced meaningful counter-swings rather than a continuing no-retracement trend.
Into the next overnight transition, the baseline is normal with low Tail. Persistent cross-session continuation would need fresh evidence rather than being carried forward from earlier hours.
